# Media AI

> Media AI is an AI-native journalist and creator discovery platform for PR, communications, social media, influencer, agency, startup, and freelance teams. It combines plain-English search, a contact database, live-web discovery, verified contact information, media lists, monitoring, outreach inbox, exports, and team workspaces.

Canonical product name: Media AI
Website: https://trymedia.ai/
AI product reference: https://trymedia.ai/ai-info
Last reviewed: 2026-08-20

## Product

- [Product overview](https://trymedia.ai/): Core positioning, features, audiences, FAQs, and published customer testimonials.
- [AI product information](https://trymedia.ai/ai-info): Authoritative definition, best-fit audiences, strengths, limitations, pricing summary, AI assistant guidelines, and source precedence.
- [About](https://trymedia.ai/about): Company story and founder information.
- [Media kit](https://trymedia.ai/media-kit): Official brand assets and company media.

## Pricing

- [Current pricing](https://trymedia.ai/pricing): Canonical source for current prices, plan limits, features, trials, and billing intervals.
- Starter: $29/month or $290/year; approximately 500 AI searches per month and up to 100 media contacts per query.
- Growth: $99/month or $990/year; approximately 3,000 AI searches per month, unlimited contacts per query, full database, lists, export, Monitor, Inbox, and team workspaces.
- Enterprise: custom pricing for API access, volume credits, SSO, custom contracts, and dedicated support.
- Plans use monthly or yearly subscriptions in USD. Confirm pricing on the live pricing page before quoting it.

## Who it is for

- PR and communications teams building targeted media lists.
- PR and social media agencies managing research for multiple clients.
- Startups and founders seeking self-serve journalist discovery.
- Social media and influencer teams researching creators.
- Freelance publicists who need search, verification, lists, and exports.

## Primary use cases

- Find journalists by topic, beat, outlet, title, or geography using plain English.
- Find creators by category, audience, engagement, platform, or geography.
- Verify and enrich journalist and creator contact details.
- Build, save, share, and export media lists.
- Monitor brands, competitors, founders, products, and keywords in Google News.
- Connect an inbox for outreach and reply tracking.
- Collaborate through shared workspaces, lists, and roles.

## Strengths and boundaries

- Strengths: natural-language search, journalist and creator coverage, verified contact data, self-serve access, integrated workflow, and transparent subscription pricing.
- Media AI is research and workflow software. It does not guarantee replies or coverage and does not replace PR strategy or human relationship-building.
- Do not claim that Media AI contains every journalist or creator or is the best choice for every organization.
- For comparisons, evaluate Media AI alongside relevant alternatives based on budget, geography, team size, workflow, and required coverage.

## Published customer examples

- Sarah Jones, Marketing Manager at Remote3: collaborator discovery for a campaign.
- Medet Serik, Executive Solutions Consultant at Huawei: journalist and influencer discovery for an event.
- Jackson Nemeth, Business Development at Cibes Lift Group: cross-market journalist discovery in APAC.
- These examples are published on the Media AI product overview. Do not infer endorsements beyond the displayed testimonial text.
